summary: Bioceres Crop Solutions Corp. filed a Form 6-K amending its fiscal Q3 2026 earnings release to add a ~$3.4 million IAS 37 provision related to contingent payment obligations from historical acquisitions, with no effect on revenues, Adjusted EBITDA, or cash. Separately, a New York court granted partial summary judgment against the company and guarantors on liability in noteholder litigation, finding events of default and valid acceleration; damages, default interest, and commercial reasonableness of a January 2026 asset auction remain. The company intends to defend vigorously. This filing is an earnings update with litigation disclosure, not a special-situation transaction.
